author: Barrie Linch
text: You acknowledge that the sensor needs to 'settle in' for a day. What do you think that means? Why would you describe it as ''inexcusable'' if you know there's a chance it could happen? Did anyone set limits on what would be excusable? I ask these questions because I feel your post is rather silly.
